rationale: This 2012 record (authored by Caroline Vout with Katherine Wentworth Rinne listed as reviewed book author) is a journal book review of Rinne's 2010 urban and architectural history monograph on aqueducts and fountains in Baroque Rome, as shown by the publication details, page/image count and book price in the abstract. As a book review rather than primary empirical research or a systematic review, and focused on historical Baroque urbanism rather than household/community water or sanitation service access and legal/administrative mechanisms, it is clearly excluded (E05).
plain_vs_narrow_note: No difference between plain and narrow Criterion 2 readings: the record is a book review of an urban/architectural history monograph on Baroque Rome and is excluded under both readings for lacking empirical research evidence and relevant legal/service-access analysis.
